items.source: WARNING: Using @TestBean in conjunction with @ContextHierarchy can lead to undesirable results since each @TestBean will be applied to all context hierarchy levels by default. To ensure that a particular @TestBean is applied to a single context hierarchy level, set the contextName to match a configured @ContextConfiguration name. See the Javadoc for @ContextHierarchy for further details and examples.
items.translation: 警告：将 @TestBean 与 @ContextHierarchy 结合使用可能会导致不理想的结果，因为每个 @TestBean 默认会应用于所有上下文层次级别。要确保特定的 @TestBean 仅应用于单个上下文层次级别，请将 contextName 设置为与配置的 @ContextConfiguration 的name 匹配。有关更多详细信息和示例，请参阅 @ContextHierarchy 的 Javadoc。

items.source: By default, the bean to override is inferred from the type of the annotated field. If multiple candidates exist, a @Qualifier annotation can be used to help disambiguate. In the absence of a @Qualifier annotation, the name of the annotated field will be used as a fallback qualifier. Alternatively, you can explicitly specify a bean name to replace by setting the value or name attribute.
items.translation: 默认情况下，要覆盖的 Bean 是从已注解字段的类型推断出来的。如果存在多个候选项，可以使用 `@Qualifier` 注解来帮助消除歧义。如果没有 `@Qualifier` 注解，则使用已注解字段的名称作为后备限定符。或者，您可以通过设置 value 或 name 属性来显式指定要替换的 Bean 名称。

items.source: NOTE: When overriding a non-singleton bean, the non-singleton bean will be replaced with a singleton bean corresponding to the value returned from the @TestBean factory method, and the corresponding bean definition will be converted to a singleton. Consequently, if you override a prototype or scoped bean, it will be treated as a singleton. Similarly, when overriding a bean created by a FactoryBean, the FactoryBean will be replaced with a singleton bean corresponding to the value returned from the @TestBean factory method.
items.translation: 注意：在覆盖非单例 Bean 时，该非单例 Bean 将被替换为与从 @TestBean 工厂方法返回的值相对应的单例 Bean，并且相应的 Bean 定义将转换为单例。因此，如果您覆盖原型或作用域 Bean，它将被视为单例。同样地，在覆盖由 FactoryBean 创建的 Bean 时，FactoryBean 将被替换为与从 @TestBean 工厂方法返回的值相对应的单例 Bean。

items.source: A bean will be created if a corresponding bean does not exist. However, if you would like for the test to fail when a corresponding bean does not exist, you can set the enforceOverride attribute to true — for example, @TestBean(enforceOverride = true).
items.translation: 如果不存在对应的 Bean，则会创建一个 Bean。但是，如果您希望在不存在对应 Bean 时使测试失败，可以将 `enforceOverride` 属性设置为 `true`——例如，`@TestBean(enforceOverride = true)`。

items.source: The instance is created from a zero-argument static factory method whose return type is compatible with the annotated field. The factory method can be declared directly in the class which declares the @TestBean field or within the type hierarchy above that class, including implemented interfaces. If the @TestBean field is declared in a nested test class, the enclosing class hierarchy is also searched. Alternatively, a factory method in an external class can be referenced via its fully-qualified method name following the syntax <fully-qualified class name>#<method name> — for example, @TestBean(methodName = "org.example.TestUtils#createCustomerRepository").
items.translation: 该实例由一个无参数静态工厂方法创建，其返回类型与已注解的字段兼容。该工厂方法可以直接在声明 `@TestBean` 字段的类中定义，也可以在该类的类型层次结构中定义，包括实现的接口。如果 `@TestBean` 字段是在嵌套测试类中声明的，则也会搜索其外部类层次结构。或者，可以通过完全限定方法名引用外部类中的工厂方法，语法为 `<fully-qualified class name>#<method name>` —— 例如，`@TestBean(methodName = "org.example.TestUtils#createCustomerRepository")`。

items.source: In the example above, the repository bean is replaced by the instance generated by the repository() method. Not only is the overridden instance injected into the repository field, but it is also replaced in the BeanFactory so that other injection points for that bean use the overridden bean instance.
items.translation: 在上面的示例中，`repository` Bean 被由 `repository()` 方法生成的实例所替换。不仅重写的实例被注入到 `repository` 字段中，而且它也在 `BeanFactory` 中被替换，以便该 Bean 的其他注入点使用重写后的 Bean 实例。

items.source: There are no restrictions on the visibility of @TestBean fields or factory methods. Such fields and methods can therefore be public, protected, package-private (default visibility), or private depending on the needs or coding practices of the project.
items.translation: `@TestBean` 字段或工厂方法的可见性没有限制。因此，这些字段和方法可以是 `public`、`protected`、包私有（默认可见性）或 `private`，具体取决于项目的需求或编码实践。

items.source: @TestBean fields will be inherited from an enclosing test class by default. See @NestedTestConfiguration for details.
items.translation: `@TestBean` 字段默认将从其封闭的测试类继承。有关详细信息，请参阅 @NestedTestConfiguration。

items.source: If left unspecified, the name of the factory method will be detected based either on the name of the @TestBean field or the name of the bean.
items.translation: 如果未指定，工厂方法名将根据 `@TestBean` 字段的名称或 bean 的name进行推断。

items.source: A search will be performed to find the factory method in the class in which the @TestBean field is declared, in one of its superclasses, or in any implemented interfaces. If the @TestBean field is declared in a nested test class, the enclosing class hierarchy will also be searched.
items.translation: 将执行搜索以在声明 `@TestBean` 字段的类、其任一父类或任何实现的接口中查找工厂方法。如果 `@TestBean` 字段是在嵌套测试类中声明的，则还将搜索其外部类层次结构。

items.source: Alternatively, a factory method in an external class can be referenced via its fully-qualified method name following the syntax <fully-qualified class name>#<method name> — for example, @TestBean(methodName = "org.example.TestUtils#createCustomerRepository").
items.translation: 或者，可以通过其完全限定方法名引用外部类中的工厂方法，语法为 `<fully-qualified class name>#<method name>`——例如，`@TestBean(methodName = "org.example.TestUtils#createCustomerRepository")`。

items.source: Intended to be used when no other attributes are needed — for example, @TestBean("customBeanName").
items.translation: 用于无需其他属性的情况——例如，@TestBean("customBeanName")。

items.source: If left unspecified, the bean to override is selected according to the annotated field's type, taking qualifiers into account if necessary. See the class-level documentation for details.
items.translation: 如果未指定，将根据注解字段的类型选择要覆盖的 Bean，如有必要则考虑限定符。有关详细信息，请参阅类级别文档。

items.source: Defaults to an empty string which indicates that this @TestBean should be applied to all application contexts.
items.translation: 默认为空字符串，表示应将此 `@TestBean` 应用于所有应用程序上下文。

items.source: If a context name is configured, it must match a name configured via @ContextConfiguration(name=...).
items.translation: 如果配置了上下文名称，它必须与通过 `@ContextConfiguration(name=...)` 配置的名称匹配。

items.source: Defaults to false which means that a bean will be created if a corresponding bean does not exist.
items.translation: 默认为false，这意味着如果不存在对应的 bean，将创建一个 bean。

items.source: Set to true to cause an exception to be thrown if a corresponding bean does not exist.
items.translation: 设置为true，以便在找不到对应的 bean 时抛出异常。

items.source: The factory method is deduced as follows.
items.translation: 工厂方法推导如下。

items.source: Consider the following example.
items.translation: 考虑以下示例。

items.source:
To make things more explicit, the bean and method names can be set,
as shown in the following example.
items.translation: 为了使说明更加明确，可以设置 Bean 和方法名称，如下例所示。

items.source: If the methodName is specified, Spring looks for a static method with that name.
items.translation: 如果指定了 `methodName`，Spring 会查找具有该名称的静态方法。

items.source: If a method name is not specified, Spring looks for exactly one static method whose name is either the name of the annotated field or the name of the bean (if specified).
items.translation: 如果未指定方法名称，Spring 会查找恰好一个静态方法，其名称为已注解字段的名称或（如果指定）bean 的name。

items.source: Alias for name().
items.translation: `name()` 的别名。

items.source: The name of the context hierarchy level in which this @TestBean should be applied.
items.translation: 此 `@TestBean` 应应用到的上下文层次结构级别的名称。

items.source: Whether to require the existence of the bean being overridden.
items.translation: 是否要求被覆盖的 Bean 必须存在。

items.source:
Name of the static factory method that will be used to instantiate the bean
to override.
items.translation: 用于覆盖以实例化该 Bean 的静态工厂方法名称。

items.source: Name of the bean to override.
items.translation: 要覆盖的 Bean 名称。
